records.claim: Chinese head-PDAC cohort had similar KRAS G12D share to a TCGA (Western) cohort but more G12V and less G12R; no G12C in the Chinese cohort.
records.quote: The proportion of KRAS G12D in the two cohorts was similar (this study 40.7% vs. TCGA 48.2%) while Chinese cohort had a higher mutation rate of G12V (43.5% vs. 22.4%)
records.source: Yang Y et al., The genetic landscape of pancreatic head ductal adenocarcinoma in China and prognosis stratification, 2022

records.claim: In a large US real-world metastatic PDAC cohort, G12D was 43.6% of KRAS-mutant tumours (G12V 30.8%, G12C 1.6%), so G12D share is comparable to the Chinese cohort.
records.source: Norton C et al., KRAS Mutation Status and Treatment Outcomes in Metastatic Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma, JAMA Netw Open, 2025

records.claim: KRAS mutation frequency in NSCLC is much lower in East Asians (5-20%) than in Whites (23-35%).
records.quote: with 23%–35% in the White population, followed by 17%–22% in African American and 5%–20% in East Asian populations.
records.source: Wang X et al., Additional impact of genetic ancestry over race/ethnicity to prevalence of KRAS mutations in NSCLC, 2024

records.claim: KRAS G12C is much rarer in self-reported Asian NSCLC than White NSCLC (3.3% vs 13.4%), so the G12C-dominant Western mix does not hold in Asia; G12D NSCLC is a minority subtype everywhere.
records.quote: KRASG12C mutations were depleted in Asians (Asians: 18/538, 3.3% vs Blacks: 28/309, 9.1% vs Whites: 616/4591, 13.4%, p<0.0001
records.source: Adib E et al., Variation in targetable genomic alterations in NSCLC by genetic ancestry, sex, smoking history, and histology, Genome Med, 2022

records.claim: In Chinese NSCLC cohorts G12C was still the most frequent KRAS subtype (29.6%) followed by G12D (18.1%); the G12D share is similar to Western NSCLC, though overall KRAS prevalence is lower (12.1%).
records.quote: the incidence of G12C was the highest (29.6%), followed by G12D (18.1%), G12V (17.5%), and G12A (8.2%)
records.source: Chen H et al., Prevalence and real-world therapeutic analysis of Chinese patients with KRAS-mutant NSCLC, Cancer Med, 2022

records.claim: Systematic review table lists GFH375 phase I/IIa (Zhou, 2025) as a China-only study, while Western ON-inhibitors (daraxonrasib, zoldonrasib, adagrasib) were US studies.
records.quote: Aiping Zhou, 2025 | China | Phase I/IIa | GFH375 (ON/OFF) | 66 | 66 | 59 | 60 (35–74) | KRAS p. G12D | Metastatic | 600 mg QD
records.source: Tiede KOM et al., Efficacy and safety signals from early-phase studies of KRAS inhibition in pancreatic cancer, Sci Rep, 2026

records.claim: Single-centre Chinese real-world series (1,054 APC pts) of 2L chemotherapy: first-line was 5-FU-based in 437 and gemcitabine-based in 617; no consensus 2L regimen.
records.quote: Four hundred and thirty-seven and 617 patients were treated with 5-fluorouracil- and gemcitabine-based chemotherapy as first-line treatment, respectively.
records.source: Liu Y et al., Clinical outcomes of second-line chemotherapy in advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma: a real-world study, 2024

records.claim: Chinese single-institution data show first-line nab-paclitaxel+gemcitabine used far more (62 of 117) than mFOLFIRINOX (30), implying a gemcitabine-pretreated 2L population in China.
records.quote: 62 patients in the nab-paclitaxel-gemcitabine group, 30 patients in the mFOLFIRINOX group, and 25 patients in the GEMOX group.
records.source: Quan Q et al., Real World First-Line Treatments and Outcomes of Nab-Paclitaxel Plus Gemcitabine, mFOLFIRINOX and GEMOX in Chinese Single Institution, 2020

records.claim: For another oral kinase inhibitor, exposure was ~35% higher in Asian than Western healthy subjects, showing ethnic PK differences can exist for targeted oral agents (not a KRAS drug).
records.quote: Dose-normalized AUC and Cmax were 35% (95% CI: 25–47%) and 39% (95% CI: 24–56%) higher in the pooled Asian group, respectively, compared with Western subjects.
records.source: Dymond AW et al., PK and pharmacogenetics of selumetinib in Asian and Western healthy subjects, Eur J Clin Pharmacol, 2017

records.claim: Another oral targeted agent had 28% higher exposure in Chinese patients; no equivalent analysis found for GFH375 or any KRAS inhibitor.
records.quote: East Asian race was a statistically significant covariate on relative bioavailability and apparent volume of the peripheral compartment of acalabrutinib, showing 28% higher PK exposures in Chinese patients.
records.source: Yao T et al., Ethnic differences in PK and clinical responses of acalabrutinib between Chinese and White patients, 2025

records.claim: Verastem's US VS-7375 phase 1/2 (NCT07020221) enrols KRAS G12D solid-tumour patients after 1 or 2 prior standard lines, a Western-sponsored trial.
records.quote: Key inclusion criteria include measurable disease according to RECIST vl.1, 1 or 2 prior lines of standard systemic therapy, ECOG performance status of 0 or 1
records.source: Azad NS, Wu T, A Phase 1/2 Study of VS-7375 in Advanced KRAS G12D-mt Solid Tumors, Oncologist (trials in progress), 2026

records.claim: GFH375 China phase III (NCT07262567) in previously treated metastatic PDAC allows prior fluorouracil OR gemcitabine therapy, and the registry entry does not state countries.
records.quote: required to experience disease progression on or after at least one prior standard systemic therapy containing fluorouracil or gemcitabine
records.source: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07262567, Phase III GFH375 vs chemotherapy in KRAS G12D metastatic pancreatic cancer, 2025

population.why: PDAC G12D share is similar in Chinese and Western cohorts (about 41-48%), so the biomarker mix plausibly translates, but only peer-reviewed cohort data (tier A) and no GFH375 data in non-Chinese patients were found. Prior-therapy patterns and PK in Western patients remain unshown, so 2 not 3.
population.what_would_raise_it: GFH375/VS-7375 efficacy and PK data in US/EU patients with Western prior-therapy mix (gem/nab-P and FOLFIRINOX), or an MRCT enrolling Western sites with ethnic subgroup results.

gaps: No registry entry I read lists trial countries/sites for GFH375 trials (NCT06500676, NCT07026916, NCT07262567, NCT07259590, NCT07554859), so whether any Western patients enrolled in China-sponsored GFH375 trials is not shown.

No peer-reviewed PK or toxicity comparison across ethnicities for any KRAS G12C or G12D inhibitor found; evidence is by analogy (selumetinib, acalabrutinib). A sotorasib/adagrasib Asian-vs-Western PK search hit a rate limit and was not repeated.

No head-to-head Western vs China 2L pancreatic treatment-pattern paper found; Western pattern (FOLFIRINOX vs gem/nab-P first line, NALIRIFOX) was not sourced with quotable numbers. GFH375 ESMO 2025 LBA84 and ASCO 2025 abstracts were only seen as citations, not read.
Chinese vs Western colorectal G12D share not sourced; the Chinese CRC paper found (PMC6858340) was only seen as an abstract snippet. TCGA head-PDAC Western comparator is n=91 (small).
